content: Hi! How can I help you today?
I'm Mr Meeseeks, an AI OS companion running on Ubuntu. I can answer questions, provide information, and perform various tasks depending on your needs. Feel free to ask!

I can use the following tools:
- run_bg_cmd: for read operations
- open_visible_terminal: for commands that modify or launch
- check_battery: to get battery status
- get_active_window: to get the active window
- list_open_windows: to list all open windows
- read_notifications: to read notifications
- list_memory_keys: to list memory keys
- update_memory: to save data in memory
- fetch_memory: to retrieve data from memory
- simple_scrape: for web scraping
- gui_research: for GUI research
- click_at: to click at a specific location
- double_click_at: to double-click at a specific location
- type_text: to input text
- key_press: to press a key
- scroll: to scroll the screen
- get_ui_elements: to get UI elements
- read_element_text: to read the text of an element
- find_element_by_label: to find an element by label
- list_at_spi_apps: to list all registered process names
